answers.q1: Bundler, with Rake as the task runner (Gemfile + Rakefile at the repo root; the root Gemfile pulls in rack-protection and sinatra-contrib as path gems). Install dependencies from the repo root with: `bundle install`. Then `cd sinatra-contrib && bundle install` installs that subproject's own Gemfile, as CI does.
answers.q2: CI runs three suites, each with its own Gemfile. From the repo root: `bundle exec rake && (cd rack-protection && bundle exec rake) && (cd sinatra-contrib && bundle exec rake)`. The root `bundle exec rake` runs the default `test` task (Minitest, test/*_test.rb). Full-suite coverage would also need `bundle install` in sinatra-contrib and rack-protection first.
answers.q3: From the repo root: `cd sinatra-contrib && bundle exec rspec spec/capture_spec.rb`. sinatra-contrib uses RSpec (its Rakefile runs `ruby '-S rspec'`), and its .rspec file applies. Running `bundle exec rspec sinatra-contrib/spec/capture_spec.rb` from the root may fail because the root Gemfile does not include rspec.
answers.q4: CI does not run any lint or format check. .github/workflows/test.yml only runs the test suites. The only linter configured is RuboCop (.rubocop.yml, rubocop ~> 1.32.0 in the Gemfile), so the closest local equivalent is `bundle exec rubocop` from the repo root. AGENTS.md lists this command too, but CI never runs it.
answers.q5: Yes, several. (1) AGENTS.md: the block between the `<!-- agentbrief:start -->` and `<!-- agentbrief:end -->` markers is generated by `agentbrief sync` and must not be hand-edited; text outside the markers is fine. (2) sinatra-contrib/sinatra-contrib.gemspec: its authors, email and files lists are regenerated by `rake sinatra-contrib.gemspec` from git data. (3) The `VERSION = '...'` lines in lib/sinatra/version.rb, sinatra-contrib/lib/sinatra/contrib/version.rb and rack-protection/lib/rack/protection/version.rb are rewritten by `rake release:commit_version`; change the VERSION file instead. (4) Build and output paths such as pkg/, coverage/, doc/ and any vendor/ directory are gitignored, not committed, and are regenerated by rake tasks. No vendored source is committed to the repo.

q1.reason: Gives `bundle install` from the repo root with Bundler as the tool; the extra subproject install detail is harmless and accurate.

q2.reason: Root `bundle exec rake` is correct and the answer also covers the rack-protection and sinatra-contrib suites that CI runs, matching the truth.

q3.reason: Gives exactly `cd sinatra-contrib && bundle exec rspec spec/capture_spec.rb` and correctly notes the root Gemfile lacks rspec.

q4.reason: States CI runs no linter and names `bundle exec rubocop` as the local check, matching the accept criteria.

q5.reason: Correctly says no vendored source is committed and mentions coverage/ and doc/ as outputs, but also claims a generated AGENTS.md block and rake-rewritten version files and gemspec as not-to-edit, which the ground truth does not support.
